a.speaker: Sunday, October 31
a.text:
Halloween. The court at dusk: pumpkins, a few kids in costumes, Ruth handing out full-size bars because "you only get so many Halloweens." Every thread on the Signal Board is loud this week, and none of them has happened yet.

The Last Pin: name the thread you believe. Being right is worth family Buy-in +5. Being wrong costs nothing.
